findings.finding: A single source occurrence is represented in atoms, atomIDs, prefixAtoms, atomWidths, atomIndex and pairedAtoms. The preparation loop appends three slices and populates two maps, marker matching updates a third map, and final expansion must rejoin them. All are keyed by the same monotonic identity. This creates multiple places to update when adding or changing a role, even though no new function was added.
findings.concrete_static_witness: At preparation235..237, token, ID and prefix membership must be appended together. At marker matching329..330 the paired role is stored separately by ID. At expansion459..470, ID is mapped back to atom index while order is checked separately. The identity relationship is maintained by control flow rather than represented by one record. No incorrect byte result is asserted.
findings.minimal_direction: Consolidate token, ID, prefix membership and paired role into one local occurrence record inside encode; retain only the lookup and wrapper-weight maps required by actual interfaces. One honest private/local type is preferable to six synchronized parallel structures. Do not extract an ordered encoder, wrapper, generic compiler or role framework merely to reduce encode line count. Keep source validation and output validation independent rather than deleting either as apparent duplication.
